name: GDPR
description: Selected duties for protecting personal data. Titles and summaries are our own short wording, not the regulation text.

requirements.title: Principles and records
requirements.summary: Why personal data is used, and how that use is written down.

children.title: Principles for processing
children.summary: Personal data is used for a clear purpose, kept accurate, and not held longer than needed.

children.title: Lawful basis
children.summary: Each use of personal data rests on a reason the organization can explain.

children.title: Records of processing
children.summary: The organization keeps a record of the processing it carries out.

requirements.title: People's rights
requirements.summary: How people can ask about, correct, or remove their personal data.

children.title: Access by the person
children.summary: A person can ask what personal data the organization holds about them.

children.title: Erasure
children.summary: A person can ask for personal data to be deleted when the organization no longer needs it.

requirements.title: Security and processors
requirements.summary: How personal data is protected and how vendors are bound.

children.title: Protection by design
children.summary: Protection of personal data is built into the product and the default settings.

children.title: Processors
children.summary: Vendors that handle personal data work under a written set of duties.

children.title: Security of processing
children.summary: The organization uses measures that fit the risk to personal data, including access control and encryption where it helps.

children.title: Breach notification
children.summary: A breach of personal data is reported to the authority on the required timeline.

children.title: Impact assessment
children.summary: High-risk processing is assessed before it starts.

children.title: Transfers
children.summary: Personal data sent to another country uses a transfer tool the organization can show.
